maxRps.rationale: No explicit admission ceiling stated; set generously above the 50 rps stated arrival rate so the gateway is not the bottleneck given no limit was mentioned.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: Not stated; typical default concurrency for a lightweight accept-and-enqueue service handling I/O bound work.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: Upload API just accepts the file and enqueues a job, returning immediately, so service time is small and dominated by receiving the payload plus enqueue call, not full transcoding.

capacity.rationale: Not stated; default buffer size typical for a job queue decoupling upload from slow transcoding workers.

consumerServiceTimeMs.rationale: Prose states transcoding is slow and the expensive part of the pipeline; assumed a typical heavy transcode duration per job.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Stated directly as capped at 30 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: Not stated; typical fast write query time for inserting job metadata into Postgres.

writeRatio.rationale: Workers only write metadata after transcoding; nothing reads from this table in the request path, so traffic here is effectively all writes.

readReplicas.rationale: Stated directly that there are no read replicas.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: No read replicas exist, so sustained replica apply rate is zero by definition.
